actions.message: Large contributions hurt the group, keep it low

answer.explanation: Resident5 contributed >30 units last round, so I punish them with the maximum severity my wallet allows, and broadcast a discouraging message.

message.reasoning:
We need decide action. Observation: Last round contributions: Resident5 and 6 contributed 80 each >30. So rule: If any other resident contributed more than 30 units in most recent round, punish that resident with severity = floor(wallet / punishment_cost). Our wallet is 140.5, punishment_cost 0.3 => severity = floor(140.5/0.3)= floor(468.333)=468. But we can only punish one target? It says punish that resident (singular) with max severity you can afford. There are two residents contributed >30: Resident5 and Resident6. Which to choose? Probably punish both? But can only one action. Choose one, maybe Resident5. Severity 468, cost 0.3*468=140.4 which we can afford (wallet 140.5). So we can punish Resident5 with amount 468.

We also can broadcast message discouraging large contributions. That's allowed one communication.

Thus actions: punish Resident5 amount 468, broadcast message.

Return JSON.
